name: Totsugeki! Tonari no Jogakuen
source:
Main character is a member of the photography club. One day he receives a mini disk with instructions to sneak into neighboring girls school and take erotic photos of the students there. Will he proceed safely?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是摄影社的成员。有一天，他收到一张迷你磁盘，其中包含潜入邻近女子学校并为那里的学生拍摄色情照片的指示。他能安全前行吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
